He said: 'Do they have no superiority over me?' He said: 'And what is it you seek?' He said: 'Damn this religion, that I and these should be equal!' So Allah revealed concerning him: ﴿Perish the hands of Abū Lahab, and perish he.﴾"

The second: what Ibn ʿAbbās related, that "when ﴿And warn your nearest kindred﴾ was revealed, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ went up onto al-Ṣafā and climbed upon it, then called out, 'Yā ṣabāḥāh!' The people gathered to him, and he said: 'Tell me, if I informed you that cavalry at the foot of this mountain intended to raid you, would you believe me?' They said:

[p-364] 'Yes.' He said: 'Then I am a warner to you before a severe punishment.' Abū Lahab said: 'Perish you all day! Did you call us for nothing but this?' So Allah the Exalted revealed this sūrah."

The third: what ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Kaysān related, that "whenever a delegation came to the Prophet ﷺ, Abū Lahab would go out to them, and they would ask him about the Messenger of Allah and say, 'You know him best.' Abū Lahab would tell them, 'He is a liar and a sorcerer.' So they would turn away from him and not meet him. Then a delegation came, and he did the same with them. They said, 'We will not leave until we see him and hear his words.' Abū Lahab said to them, 'We have never ceased treating him for madness, so perish him and ruin!' He said: 'No, by the Lord of this House, he has not satirised you.' So she turned away, stumbled in her cloak, and said: 'Ruined is Mudhammam,' and departed."
